text: @bryan-cmf/dsh-vector-memory 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 agent 持久记忆插件。它通过 DSH storageDomain 保存记忆，并注册 mem_save、mem_search、mem_health 三个工具，同时提供 vectorMemory 服务供其他插件调用。记忆可设置有效期，搜索按内容和标签的关键词重合度及时间新近程度排序；插件还注册「记憶」会话视图，展示本会话保存和检索活动。适合希望跨会话保留要点并按关键词找回的 DSH 使用者。需由宿主提供 tools、storageDomain 与持久存储后端；代码中没有配置外部 API 或密钥。

@bryan-cmf/dsh-vector-memory adds durable memory to DSH agents. mem_save stores tagged notes; mem_search finds unexpired notes by keyword and recency. mem_health reports storage status, and a 「記憶」 tab shows session activity. It needs host storage services; no external API or key is configured.
想让 DSH agent 把重要信息保存下来，之后还能找回。
怎么在不同会话之间保留 agent 的记忆并按关键词搜索？
I need a DSH memory tool that saves notes durably and finds them later by keywords.
@bryan-cmf/dsh-vector-memory 的功能「保存与检索持久记忆」：agent 可调用 mem_save 保存内容、标签和有效期，再用 mem_search 按关键词查找未过期记录；搜索结果按匹配度及新近程度排序并返回。
@bryan-cmf/dsh-vector-memory 的功能「查看记忆活动」：会话中的「記憶」视图统计保存、检索和失败活动，并按卡点、失败、技术与学习等类别展示最近条目。

@bryan-cmf/dsh-vector-memory README · 🧠 Vector Memory — DSH-Plugin：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin
that gives your agents durable, cross-session memory — the same
`mem_save` / `mem_search` contract as the original
[`Bryan-cmf/vector-memory`](https://github.com/Bryan-cmf/vector-memory) MCP
server, but **natively** on DSH.

@bryan-cmf/dsh-vector-memory README · Why a native rewrite (and what changed)：The 2026 memory landscape made self-hosting a Qdrant + BGE-m3 stack a
commodity (Zep / Mem0 / Letta / LangMem all offer managed embeddings + graph
memory). This package keeps the **agent-facing contract** and drops the
**infrastructure**:
section: Why a native rewrite (and what changed)

text:
@bryan-cmf/dsh-vector-memory README · Why a native rewrite (and what changed)：| Aspect | Old (MCP server) | This plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Storage | Qdrant (Docker) + BGE-m3 (~2GB) | **DSH `storageDomain`** — durable JSON backend, zero setup |
| Retrieval | Vector similarity | v1: deterministic keyword scoring + recency; **embeddings pluggable in v2** |
| Interface | MCP stdio (Claude/Cursor/…) | Native tools (`mem_save` / `mem_search` / `mem_health`) + `vectorMemory` service |
| Persistence | Manual install script | Bundle row — it just works |
section: Why a native rewrite (and what changed)

text:
@bryan-cmf/dsh-vector-memory README · Tools：| Tool | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `mem_save` | `{ content, tags?, ttlDays? }` → durable memory, returns id |
| `mem_search` | `{ query, limit? }` → ranked hits (score, content, tags, created) |
| `mem_health` | record count, expired count, domain status, TTL policy |

Other plugins can `inject: ['vectorMemory']` and call `save` / `search` /
`health` directly.

@bryan-cmf/dsh-vector-memory README · Dashboard：The client half registers a **「記憶」view tab** (order 30, right of
chat / 軌跡 / 觀測) listing this session's saved/searched items live.

@bryan-cmf/dsh-vector-memory README · Install：```jsonc
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@bryan-cmf/dsh-vector-memory"] } }
```

> ⚠️ This row **publishes the `vectorMemory` service** — it must live in the
> **host composition** (process-global). If you mount it from an agent preset
> instead, wrap it in a group with an `isolate` realm (see the DSH
> composition docs).

@bryan-cmf/dsh-vector-memory README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ttlDays` | `90` | Default memory TTL; `0` = forever |
| `maxResults` | `10` | Default `mem_search` result count |
